cases.title: Vendor search is debounced and limited to twenty results
steps: Enter the search term in "Search vendors".
Check the network activity or result updates before and after the 300-millisecond interval.
cases.expected: The search request is issued after the 300-millisecond debounce interval, not for every intermediate keystroke. No more than twenty vendor results are shown on the page.
cases.setup: Use a project with more than twenty vendors. Prepare a search term matching more than twenty vendors.
gaps: That the request is issued only after the 300-millisecond debounce interval rather than for each intermediate keystroke
Network activity or result updates before and after the 300-millisecond interval
The case-specific search term was not provided

steps.note: Open the prepared Participants screen where the vendor search is available.
Enter a representative vendor search term.
Verify that the visible vendor results are limited to no more than twenty.

cases.title: City filter and selected-vendor switch refine participants
steps: Choose one city in "Filter by city".
Confirm that only vendors from the chosen city are listed.
Turn on "Show only selected vendors Filter by city".
Confirm that the list contains only selected vendors from the chosen city.
Turn off "Show only selected vendors Filter by city".
cases.expected: The list first narrows to the chosen city, then narrows further to selected vendors. Turning off the switch and clearing the city filter restores the unfiltered participant list.
cases.setup: Use a project containing vendors from at least two cities, including both selected and unselected vendors.
gaps: Selecting one city in the unconfirmed "Filter by city" control because no catalog step provides a known city option value
Asserting that every displayed vendor belongs to the chosen city
Clearing or resetting the "Filter by city" control and proving the combined city-and-selection filter is fully restored

steps.note: Open the existing participant list, which is the subject under test.

Apply the supported selected-vendor filter.
Verify that enabling the selected-vendor switch changes the participant list.
Turn off the selected-vendor filter.
Verify that disabling the switch restores the previously recorded participant-list content.
